name: mpc-signing-frost
description: A 2-of-3 threshold-FROST (Ed25519) signer split between a Lit Action and the user (hot + cold recovery share) — Lit literally cannot sign without the user co-signing, the full key never exists anywhere, and the user can always recover without Lit. Targets Solana.
//frost-wasm: FROST threshold crypto (DKG + 2-round signing) over the wasm-bindgen wrapper in ./wasm (lit-frost + frost-dkg). Build it first: `cd wasm && ./build.sh` (see wasm/README.md for the two upstream patches it needs). The client requires ../wasm/pkg-node; the action imports the published ../wasm/pkg-web (pin the jsDelivr URL in action/mpcSigner.js after publishing).
